verdict.rationale: Pomelo documents its own 3D Secure capability, including configurable challenge rules and webhook delivery of challenges through the customer's own channel. That covers part of the online-credential side of the story. Nothing in the pack shows PIN set or reset endpoints, or API-driven 3DS enrollment per card or region. Missing for 10: API PIN set/reset flows, explicit 3DS enrollment endpoints, regional 3DS requirement handling, evidence that no support tickets are needed, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, cardholder credentials are manageable through the API — PIN set and reset flows, 3DS enrollment for online use where the region requires it — without support tickets
